overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee member's statements were not shown to reflect a quorum's discussion. The AG also reminded the committee of complaint-review procedure, which was not raised in the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a school committee member's statements at a May 2 pre-Town Meeting session and at the May 16 Town Meeting showed deliberation outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, we credit the Committee's statement that Mr. Ryan's statements did not reflect any discussion between or among a quorum of the Committee members, and we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the superintendent forwarded the complaint to counsel rather than the committee meeting to review it. The AG noted this only as a reminder.
allegations.key_passage: We take this opportunity to remind the Committee of its obligations under the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
